def q_to_R(q):
    w, x, y, z = q
    return [
        [1 - 2*(y*y + z*z), 2*(x*y - w*z), 2*(x*z + w*y)],
        [2*(x*y + w*z), 1 - 2*(x*x + z*z), 2*(y*z - w*x)],
        [2*(x*z - w*y), 2*(y*z + w*x), 1 - 2*(x*x + y*y)]
    ]

print("left home R:", [[round(v, 3) for v in row] for row in q_to_R(r_arm_l.output["pose_world"][3:])])
